summary.intent: Fix failing vault recovery E2E test in CI, resolve several CI/CD issues (Grafana provisioning, desktop build signing, workflow errors), and perform milestone v1.1 completion docs cleanup including updating codebase docs and creating feature/deferred items inventories.
summary.outcome: Fixed the vault recovery E2E test (protobuf field number bug + IPNS resolution order), fixed writable-shares E2E test (IPNS key lookup ID mismatch for standalone file shares), resolved Grafana API key expiry, wired Tauri signing keys into staging workflow, removed redundant build-desktop.yml workflow, ran full web E2E suite locally with NODE_ENV=test throttle relaxation, and created FEATURES.md and DEFERRED.md planning documents on a docs cleanup branch.

repo: IPNS protobuf records use field 1 for the value/CID path, field 2 for signatureV1 — recovery.html had these swapped
IPNS resolution in recovery.html was ordered wrong: slow IPFS gateway HEAD (15-30s timeout) was tried before fast delegated routing API, causing CI timeouts

Standalone file shares create a synthetic FilePointer with id=shareId, but file-ipns keys are stored with itemId=fileId — these IDs don't match, causing 'Cannot update: no file IPNS key available' error
ThrottlerModule in app.module.ts had hardcoded limits; converting to forRootAsync with NODE_ENV=test detection enables E2E test runs without throttle interference
tauri-apps/tauri-action@v1 does not exist — only @v0 (currently v0.6.2) is published; build-desktop.yml was referencing a non-existent tag

deploy-staging.yml creates GitHub releases with --prerelease flag but tauri-action was set to prerelease: false — inconsistency means /releases/latest/ URL (used by Tauri updater) would never resolve to staging releases
includeUpdaterJson was not set in any tauri-action invocation, so latest.json was never generated for the auto-updater
mock-ipns-routing stores records keyed by IPNS name; records were being stored correctly but the extractCidFromIpnsRecord function in recovery.html was reading the wrong protobuf field
Grafana Cloud health endpoint returns 404 (not 401/403) when Bearer token is invalid or expired — can be mistaken for a URL issue
The build-desktop.yml workflow was added during Phase 25 (Desktop Enhancements) for the auto-updater feature but was redundant with deploy-staging.yml

code.finding: extractCidFromIpnsRecord checked fieldNumber === 2 (signatureV1) instead of fieldNumber === 1 (value) for the IPNS CID path
Vault key blob fetch tried IPFS gateway /ipns/ path first (30s timeout) before delegated routing — in CI, Kubo can't resolve IPNS names published via mock-ipns-routing, causing 30s hang

Standalone file shares create synthetic FilePointer with id: shareItem.share.shareId, but file-ipns key in share_keys uses itemId: filePointer.id (real file UUID) — mismatch causes getFileIpnsKeyFn to return null
Fallback for file-ipns key lookup scoped to itemType === 'file' shares only to prevent wrong-key selection in folder shares
ThrottlerModule converted to forRootAsync; test mode uses 200 req/sec and 2000 req/min limits vs 10 req/sec and 100 req/min in production
Backoff retry only triggered on thrown errors, not on non-OK HTTP responses (429/5xx) — added !resp.ok check
resp.json() consumed response body then fallthrough attempted resp.arrayBuffer() — wrapped protobuf parse in else branch to prevent double-consume

workflow: Run web E2E tests with NODE_ENV=test API to prevent throttler interference; all account creation failures in full suite were caused by 429 responses from throttler

Local E2E full suite produces environment-specific failures for mfa-flows (Web3Auth infra), full-workflow CID verification timing, and recycle-bin login — these are pre-existing local-only failures, not regressions
Use gh run rerun --failed to re-trigger flaky CI jobs caused by Docker Hub pull rate limiting rather than code issues

Tauri updater requires /releases/latest/ URL to resolve — this only works if releases are NOT marked as prerelease; all three tauri-action invocations in deploy-staging.yml must have prerelease: false AND the create-desktop-release gh release create step must not use --prerelease
Playwright test timing: after textarea.fill(), React onChange updates state asynchronously — must wait for UI indicator (modified status) before sending Ctrl+S keyboard shortcut
git index.lock file left by crashed git process must be manually removed before further git operations

friction: Multiple CI round-trips needed before discovering NODE_ENV=test was required for full E2E suite — should have been set up from the start of local test runs
1Password SSH agent not accessible from subprocess environments, blocking commits — required user to run commit manually or retry
Parallel Playwright suite runs collided with each other and with background API processes, causing false failures that were hard to distinguish from real bugs
Docker Hub rate limiting/auth errors caused transient CI failures unrelated to code changes — required manual re-run
markdownlint hook blocked commit of codebase docs due to MD036 (emphasis used as heading) and bare code fences in agent-generated content — required several fix rounds
Staging deployment VPS SSH timeout (io timeout to 76.13.151.200) was transient but looked like a real failure requiring investigation
Worktree from Phase 20 debug session referenced code that no longer existed after merges — debug session had to be resolved as stale
